'''StatXact''' is a [[statistical software]] package for analyzing data using [[exact statistics]]. It calculates exact [[p-value]]s and [[confidence interval]]s for [[contingency table]]s and [[non-parametric statistics|non-parametric procedures]]. It is marketed by [[Cytel]] Inc.
